workflowBuilder.title: Account Approval Workflows
workflowBuilder.subtitle: Build account approval flows by dragging and connecting steps — no coding required.
workflowBuilder.subtitlePartner: Automate recruiting steps — jobs, applications, pipeline, interviews, offers, and candidate notifications — by dragging and connecting steps.
workflowBuilder.activateConfirmBody: Once activated, this workflow will run automatically. An active workflow cannot be edited directly — future edits create a new draft version.
workflowBuilder.readOnlyNotice: This is the active version and cannot be edited directly. Editing creates a new draft version.
workflowBuilder.advisoryNote: This step is advisory: it always pauses for a human to confirm before anything happens. No AI provider or model details are shown to end users.
workflowBuilder.badgeHumanConfirm: Prepares a draft — a person must confirm
workflowBuilder.humanConfirmNote: This step only prepares a job draft and pauses for a person to review and confirm it. It never creates or publishes a job on its own.
workflowBuilder.consequentialNote: Once this workflow is activated, this step runs automatically for each matching event. It only becomes active after an admin activates the workflow and confirms you hold the required permission.
workflowBuilder.aiCreditNote: AI evaluation mode uses AI credits.
workflowBuilder.triggerTypeHelp: This event starts the workflow. It is set now and fixed once the workflow is saved.
workflowBuilder.triggerLockedHelp: The start event is set when the workflow is first created and can't be changed. Clone the workflow to use a different start event.
workflowBuilder.triggerFileUploaded: A file (e.g. a JD) is uploaded
workflowBuilder.screenModeDeterministicHelp: Uses the free CV–JD fit engine. No AI credits are used.
workflowBuilder.screenModeLlmHelp: Runs a metered AI evaluation. Falls back to the deterministic fit if AI is unavailable.
workflowBuilder.thresholdOrderHelp: The strong threshold must be at or above the consider threshold.
workflowBuilder.applicationVariableHelp: Which flow variable holds the application to screen. Defaults to the one from the start event.
workflowBuilder.autoAdvanceHelp: Advances the candidate to the next stage only when that stage's gate is already met. It never bypasses the gate, and it won't advance the same candidate twice.
workflowBuilder.notifyTemplateHelp: The notification template to send. Only active templates are listed.
workflowBuilder.notifyNoTemplatesHelp: No active templates found — enter a template key.
workflowBuilder.recipientModeTriggerVar: A person from a flow variable
workflowBuilder.recipientAssigneeHelp: Sends to whoever is assigned to the triggering application.
workflowBuilder.recipientUserErrorHelp: Couldn't load team members. Try again shortly.
workflowBuilder.recipientVariableHelp: The chosen variable must resolve to a platform user.
workflowBuilder.jdPdfHelp: Turns an uploaded JD into a job draft proposal, then pauses for a person to confirm and create it. Pair it with a "file uploaded" start event. It never publishes a job automatically.
workflowBuilder.conflictBody: This workflow was updated elsewhere. Reloading the latest data.
workflowBuilder.permissionDeniedBody: Only members granted this permission can view or edit workflows.
workflowBuilder.listEmptyBody: Create your first workflow to automate account approval or recruiting steps.
workflowBuilder.archiveConfirmBody: Archiving is permanent for this version — it cannot be reactivated. Clone it first if you may need to run it again.
workflowBuilder.dryRunSimulatedBadge: Simulated test run — no real notifications, pipeline moves, or records were created
workflowBuilder.dryRunResultBody: This is a simulation against a synthetic sample event with sensitive fields redacted.
workflowBuilder.noDryRunYetBody: Run a test to see how this flow would behave against a sample event, with no real side effects.
workflowBuilder.noTasksBody: Failed steps from real runs will show up here for manual follow-up.
workflowBuilder.tasksUnavailableForNewBody: Recoverable tasks appear once this workflow has been saved and has run at least once.
workflowBuilder.executionHistoryUnavailableBody: Per-run history for real executions is tracked internally but not yet exposed through an API. This view will list real runs (status, actor, reason, and user-safe errors) once that endpoint ships.
workflowBuilder.activationBlockedBody: This workflow performs actions outside your current permissions. Ask an admin to grant these, or remove the steps you don't have access to.
